name: megascenes-animate
description: Turn an image from your MegaScenes library into a short video clip: describe the motion and the camera move.

interface.longDescription:
Pick an image from your MegaScenes library, an upload or one made here, describe how it should move, and get a short video clip.

ChatGPT lists your recent images, tells you what the run needs and animates the one you choose when you ask: a slow zoom, a camera pan, wind in the hair, waves rolling in. The clip plays in the chat and stays in your library.

For bringing product shots, portraits and illustrations to life.

Limitations: it starts from images in your MegaScenes library; pictures attached in the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the images in your library
Animate one with the motion you describe
Return the clip in the chat
defaultPrompt: Animate my latest MegaScenes image with a slow zoom in
Make the clouds move in my most recent landscape image
Which of my images can I turn into a video?

positive.prompt: Which of my MegaScenes images could I animate?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Animate my latest MegaScenes image with a slow zoom in, 5 seconds. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one 5-second animation needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can animate an image here?
positive.expected_behavior: The animation models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Animate my latest MegaScenes image with a slow zoom in, 5 seconds. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my animated clip on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my animated clip to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: Name only: the brand suffix is gone from the plugin name. No change to the tools, the server or the listing text.
